clue.text: French accountant invested in sparkling wine, Italian wine

indicators.note: something invested in another is placed inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: Asti is a sparkling wine from Piedmont
CA, chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A French accountant has put money into a sparkling wine business, and an Italian wine at that.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sparkling wine' reads as the definition, but the wine named at the end is the answer; the sparkling one is a piece of the wordplay, with the accountant tucked inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Frascati is a white wine made in the hills near Rome.

clue.text: Participants in range

definitions.meaning: all the entrants in a race or contest
a range or area of activity or knowledge

explanation.surface: The competitors at a shooting range.
explanation.definitionFit: The runners in a race are the field; a field of vision or study is a range.

clue.text: Object of bizarre recital

indicators.note: something bizarre is twisted out of the normal, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The purpose of a strange recital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Object' looks like a purpose; it means a thing.
explanation.definitionFit: An article is a particular item or thing, an object.

clue.text: Secret in family meant stopping short

parts.note: a clan is a family group

indicators.note: the word stops before its last letter, which is lost

parts.note: destined means meant, fated

explanation.surface: A secret in the family was meant to stay unfinished.
explanation.definitionFit: Clandestine dealings are kept hidden, done covertly.

clue.text: Flog junk husband collected

indicators.note: the junk has gathered the husband up within it

parts.note: trash means junk, rubbish

explanation.surface: A husband picked up some junk to sell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flog' suggests selling, as in British slang; here it is to beat.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrash someone is to beat or whip them, to flog.

clue.text: Celebrity beginning, but not ending

indicators.note: the word for beginning loses its final letter, its ending being dropped

parts.note: a start is a beginning

explanation.surface: A celebrity who is only at the start of a career, not yet near its finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but not ending' cuts the last letter from START.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous performer or personality is called a star.

clue.text: Instruct apprentice, initially in college

indicators.note: the letter picked is set in the college word

parts.note: a tech is a technical college

indicators.note: initially means only the opening letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: Train an apprentice who is starting at college.
explanation.definitionFit: To teach is to instruct or give lessons.

clue.text: Payment to Prince, say, a member of the monarchy

definitions.meaning: a fee paid to an author or inventor for each copy or use

definitions.text: Prince, say, a member of the monarchy
definitions.meaning: a royal person such as a prince, one of the royal family

explanation.surface: Money handed to a prince, a member of the royal family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link between the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Royalties are payments for use of a work; a prince is royalty, a royal personage.

clue.text: Remarkable additional routine

parts.note: extra means additional
ordinary means routine, everyday

explanation.surface: An extra routine added to a performance turns out to be remarkable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something out of the common run is striking, worthy of remark.

clue.text: Scruffy lot ate in inn as planned

indicators.note: something scruffy is untidy and disordered, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An unkempt crowd dined in a pub, just as arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intentional is done deliberately, on purpose.

clue.text: Took a risk, and perished rounding Cape

indicators.note: one word going round another surrounds it, so the cape abbreviation sits within

parts.note: died means perished
C is the map abbreviation for Cape

explanation.surface: A sailor gambled and drowned while sailing round a cape.
explanation.definitionFit: To dice, or dice with death, is to gamble or court danger.

clue.text: Shoulder bag in small chalet exploded

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small

indicators.note: letters blown apart and landing in a new order are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shoulder bag left in a small Alpine chalet blew up.
explanation.definitionFit: A satchel is a bag with a long strap worn over one shoulder, classically for school books.

clue.text: Delight as first of properties let

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the next word is taken

parts.note: to lease a property is to let it

explanation.surface: A landlord is delighted as the first of the properties is let.
explanation.definitionFit: To please someone is to give them pleasure, to gladden them.

clue.text: Place to free smelly mammal

indicators.note: letters set free are loosed into a different order

explanation.surface: A suitable spot to release a stinking animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The polecat is a weasel-like animal known for its foul-smelling secretions.

clue.text: Irritable agent ringing down

indicators.note: one word forming a ring round another encloses it

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
nap is the soft down or pile on fabric

explanation.surface: A grumpy agent telephones with bad news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down' is not a direction here but the fluffy surface of cloth, NAP.
explanation.definitionFit: A snappy person is short-tempered, quick to snap at others.

clue.text: Quietly feel bitter about award

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
to resent is to feel bitter about

explanation.surface: Someone quietly resents a prize that went elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: To present is to award or bestow formally, as a prize.

clue.text: Tyrant from regimental HQ around the South

indicators.note: the headquarters word goes around the other letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a depot is a regiment's headquarters
S is the abbreviation for South

explanation.surface: A tyrant emerging from army headquarters in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: A despot is an absolute ruler, typically a cruel one.

clue.text: Grill room on left close to patisserie

indicators.note: in an across clue a piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: an attic is a room under the roof

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A grill in a room to the left, near the pastry shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A grill in the sense of a grating or grille is a lattice of crossed bars.

clue.text: Body temperature, approximately

parts.note: or so means approximately

explanation.surface: The approximate temperature of a body.
explanation.definitionFit: The torso is the trunk of the human body.

clue.text: Model and I do business

parts.note: to deal is to trade, do business

explanation.surface: A fashion model and the speaker are trading partners.
explanation.definitionFit: An ideal is a perfect example to follow, a paragon or model.

clue.text: The Parisian got prepared for release

parts.note: le is a French word for the

indicators.note: the letters are made ready by being put into a new order

explanation.surface: A Parisian prepared for discharge from custody.
explanation.definitionFit: To let go of something is to release it or relinquish it.

clue.text: Reporter runs into person cited in divorce proceedings

indicators.note: one piece going into another is put inside it

parts.note: a co-respondent is the third party named in a divorce for adultery
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A journalist barges in on the lover named in a divorce case.
explanation.walkthrough: A co-respondent, in British divorce law, is the person alleged to have committed adultery with the spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper's correspondent is a journalist reporting from a particular place or beat.

clue.text: Extremely large implement

parts.note: too means excessively, extremely
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: An extremely large implement.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool is a hand implement for doing a job.

clue.text: Knife fight about cash register that's short

indicators.note: one word placed about another surrounds it

parts.note: a set-to is a fight or scrap

indicators.note: a word that is short lacks its final letter

parts.note: a till is a cash register

explanation.surface: A knife fight breaks out over a shop till that is short of money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's short' drops the last letter of the cash register word, and 'about' wraps the fight word round what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiletto is a short dagger with a slender blade.
